mapper.insert: insert into kg_relationships ( id, source_entity_id, target_entity_id, relation_type, source_book, confidence, context_note, created_at, updated_at ) values ( #{relationship.id, jdbcType=OTHER, typeHandler=com.zhangspaghetti.babytalk.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler}, #{relationship.sourceEntityId, jdbcType=OTHER, typeHandler=com.zhangspaghetti.babytalk.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler}, #{relationship.targetEntityId, jdbcType=OTHER, typeHandler=com.zhangspaghetti.babytalk.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler}, #{relationship.relationType}, #{relationship.sourceBook}, #{relationship.confidence}, #{relationship.contextNote}, #{relationship.createdAt}, #{relationship.updatedAt} )
mapper.select: select id, source_entity_id, target_entity_id, relation_type, source_book, confidence, context_note, created_at, updated_at from kg_relationships where id = #{id, jdbcType=OTHER, typeHandler=com.zhangspaghetti.babytalk.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler}

select id, source_entity_id, target_entity_id, relation_type, source_book, confidence, context_note, created_at, updated_at from kg_relationships where source_entity_id = #{sourceEntityId, jdbcType=OTHER, typeHandler=com.zhangspaghetti.babytalk.mybatis.UuidTypeHandler} order by created_at
